title: FlashAttention with Statistics: Low-Overhead Attention Features for Compact Hallucination Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2610.21483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can produce fluent answers that the supplied context does not support. A compact frozen proxy model can detect such answers by reading the context and another model's response, even from a proprietary generator. Attention-based detectors use summary statistics of the proxy's attention weights, but standard pipelines materialize the attention matrix, whose memory grows quadratically with sequence length. We compute these statistics without materializing attention, by accumulation in the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups after it, or a second tiled pass over the scores, and classify them by this path into nearly free and costlier ones. On an H100, the statistics of five published detectors add 16% to the latency of a Qwen3-8B forward at 2K tokens, falling to 1.4% at 35K, and store 22.5 KiB per response token. On three benchmarks, probes trained on frozen Qwen3 proxies of 0.6B to 8B parameters prove strong detectors:

translated_title: 带统计量的FlashAttention：用于紧凑型幻觉检测器的低开销注意力特征
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可能生成所提供的上下文无法支持的流畅回答。一个紧凑的冻结代理模型可以通过阅读上下文和另一个模型的回答来检测这类回答，即使回答来自专有生成器也适用。基于注意力的检测器使用代理模型注意力权重的汇总统计量，但标准流水线需要将注意力矩阵显式实例化，其内存占用随序列长度呈二次增长。我们在不显式实例化注意力矩阵的情况下计算这些统计量：通过在FlashAttention前向传播过程中累加、之后进行稀疏查找，或对注意力分数进行第二次分块计算，并按此路径将统计量分类为几乎零开销和开销较大的两类。在H100上，五个已发表检测器的统计量在2K token时使Qwen3-8B前向传播延迟增加16%，在35K token时降至1.4%，每个响应token存储22.5 KiB。在三个基准测试中，基于0.6B到8B参数的冻结Qwen3代理模型训练的探针被证明是强大的检测器：
tldr: 该论文提出在不显式实例化注意力矩阵的前提下，通过FlashAttention过程中的累加、稀疏查找或第二次分块计算来低开销地获取注意力统计特征，使基于紧凑冻结代理模型的幻觉检测器几乎不增加推理延迟和内存开销。
en_tdlr: This paper computes attention summary statistics without materializing the attention matrix—via accumulation within the FlashAttention pass, sparse lookups, or a second tiled pass—enabling low-overhead, compact hallucination detectors.
